cases.name: a stale graph detaches the rebuild and the hook returns at once
cases.cmd:
d={{FIX}}/autosync-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $d/graphify-out $d/src $d/bin; printf '{}' > $d/graphify-out/graph.json; touch -t 202001010000 $d/graphify-out/graph.json; echo 'class A {}' > $d/src/A.cs; printf '#!/bin/bash
sleep 3
touch "$2/graphify-out/graph.json"
echo updated
' > $d/bin/graphify; chmod +x $d/bin/graphify; s=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())'); printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | GRAPHIFY_REPO=$d GRAPHIFY_BIN=$d/bin/graphify GRAPHIFY_HOOK_LOG=/tmp/claude-autosync-log-{{SID}} GRAPHIFY_AUTOSYNC_LOCK=/tmp/claude-autosync-lock-{{SID}} bash {{KIT}}/hooks/graphify-autosync.sh; e=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())'); speed=$(python3 -c "print('fast' if $e-$s < 2 else 'slow')"); sleep 5; echo "$speed:$(grep -c 'update OK' /tmp/claude-autosync-log-{{SID}})"

cases.name: an up-to-date graph spawns nothing
cases.cmd: d={{FIX}}/autosync-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $d/graphify-out $d/src $d/bin; echo 'class A {}' > $d/src/A.cs; touch -t 202001010000 $d/src/A.cs; printf '{}' > $d/graphify-out/graph.json; printf '#!/bin/bash\necho never\n' > $d/bin/graphify; chmod +x $d/bin/graphify; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | GRAPHIFY_REPO=$d GRAPHIFY_BIN=$d/bin/graphify GRAPHIFY_HOOK_LOG=/tmp/claude-autosync-log-{{SID}} GRAPHIFY_AUTOSYNC_LOCK=/tmp/claude-autosync-lock-{{SID}} bash {{KIT}}/hooks/graphify-autosync.sh; tail -1 /tmp/claude-autosync-log-{{SID}}

cases.name: a missing graph is an alert, never a rebuild
cases.cmd: d={{FIX}}/autosync-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $d/src $d/bin; echo 'class A {}' > $d/src/A.cs; printf '#!/bin/bash\necho never\n' > $d/bin/graphify; chmod +x $d/bin/graphify; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | GRAPHIFY_REPO=$d GRAPHIFY_BIN=$d/bin/graphify GRAPHIFY_HOOK_LOG=/tmp/claude-autosync-log-{{SID}} GRAPHIFY_AUTOSYNC_LOCK=/tmp/claude-autosync-lock-{{SID}} bash {{KIT}}/hooks/graphify-autosync.sh; tail -1 /tmp/claude-autosync-log-{{SID}}

cases.name: graphify on the PATH only, GRAPHIFY_BIN unset: the rebuild runs
cases.cmd:
d={{FIX}}/autosync-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $d/graphify-out $d/src $d/bin $d/home; printf '{}' > $d/graphify-out/graph.json; touch -t 202001010000 $d/graphify-out/graph.json; echo 'class A {}' > $d/src/A.cs; printf '#!/bin/bash
touch "$2/graphify-out/graph.json"
echo updated
' > $d/bin/graphify; chmod +x $d/bin/graphify; P=$(printf '%s' "$PATH" | tr ':' '
' | while IFS= read -r x; do [ -e "$x/graphify" ] || [ -e "$x/graphify.exe" ] || printf '%s:' "$x"; done); unset GRAPHIFY_BIN; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | HOME=$d/home PATH="$d/bin:$P" GRAPHIFY_REPO=$d GRAPHIFY_HOOK_LOG=/tmp/claude-autosync-log-{{SID}} GRAPHIFY_AUTOSYNC_LOCK=/tmp/claude-autosync-lock-{{SID}} bash {{KIT}}/hooks/graphify-autosync.sh; sleep 3; grep -c 'update OK' /tmp/claude-autosync-log-{{SID}}

cases.name: graphify nowhere: an alert naming what was tried, exit 0
cases.cmd:
d={{FIX}}/autosync-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $d/graphify-out $d/src $d/home; printf '{}' > $d/graphify-out/graph.json; touch -t 202001010000 $d/graphify-out/graph.json; echo 'class A {}' > $d/src/A.cs; P=$(printf '%s' "$PATH" | tr ':' '
' | while IFS= read -r x; do [ -e "$x/graphify" ] || [ -e "$x/graphify.exe" ] || printf '%s:' "$x"; done); unset GRAPHIFY_BIN; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | HOME=$d/home PATH="$P" GRAPHIFY_REPO=$d GRAPHIFY_HOOK_LOG=/tmp/claude-autosync-log-{{SID}} GRAPHIFY_AUTOSYNC_LOCK=/tmp/claude-autosync-lock-{{SID}} bash {{KIT}}/hooks/graphify-autosync.sh; tail -1 /tmp/claude-autosync-log-{{SID}}

expect.stdout: ALERT graphify not found (GRAPHIFY_BIN unset, not on PATH, not in ~/.local/bin)
